components: A live member emits a heartbeat with its identity and epoch.
The receiver records the latest observed heartbeat time.
No heartbeat arrives before the suspicion timeout.
The member becomes suspected rather than instantly proven dead.
Ownership is reassigned only after the configured confirmation policy.
